The most appropriate ground is **Speech or Debate Clause immunity** (U.S. Const. art. I, §6, cl. 1). Floor speeches are core legislative activity, so the clause bars the suit regardless of whether the accusation was false or negligent, which makes the pleading gap on actual malice secondary. Federal sovereign immunity is weaker because the suit targets the senator personally, not the United States.
